course_outline_concepts: Benchmark shape: multiple-choice vs generation vs open-ended; per-task metric choice
Harness architecture: lm-eval-harness / OLMES / AgentBench -- what's common, what differs
Inference-time config as part of eval: temperature, top-p, max-tokens -- these are eval hyperparameters
Slicing the harness: per-subset report, per-difficulty-bucket report
Versioning: when a harness update changes numbers, attribution

sources.what_to_extract: OLMES as a fully-open eval suite + its co-release with OLMo 3; design philosophy that 'the entire model flow' is the artifact -- eval included; data-curriculum vs. eval-curriculum parallelism.
Release-scale eval-suite usage (21+ benchmarks, capability axes code/math/reasoning/long-context/tool); the need to slice per capability when reporting a frontier model.
MT-Bench judge-as-harness: position / verbosity / self-enhancement biases; swap-and-average protocol; reference-guided grading; LLM-judge agreement 80% with humans = harness agreement ceiling.
RULER as a *parameterized task generator* separating length from complexity; 13-task suite; recall-based metric; effective context size vs claimed window -- the harness is a generator plus a matcher.
Natural-task complement to synthetic RULER/NIAH; 21 tasks; task-specific metrics (F1 / ROUGE / accuracy); bilingual; contamination risk from older sources.
NIAH heatmap as the minimum viable long-context harness; exact-substring vs LLM-judge matcher; over-reporting gotcha.
AST matcher + executable eval for function-calling; multi-category scoring; V1 saturated, V2-Live / V3-multi-turn / V4-agentic as version-generation progression; pass^k metric.
Hybrid synthetic-natural harness: reasoning templates + PG19 distractors, scales to 10M tokens; why generated benchmarks resist contamination.
Behavior library + attack wrapper separation; held-out success classifier (Llama-2-13B-chat fine-tune) vs substring matching; validation/test split rule for attack-defense co-evolution.
WildGuardTest as an eval suite with human-annotated agreement columns; three task labels (prompt harm / response harm / refusal) treated separately; kappa as harness-reliability signal.
Hierarchical 6-16-66 taxonomy + MD-Judge; per-category slicing as the reporting unit; attack-enhanced variants as version extensions.
AgentBench-adjacent: self-hosted reproducible environment; predicate-based success; Docker pinning as a versioning primitive; observation mode (AX tree vs screenshot).
Don't trust a single aggregate metric; tail-mass slicing; external verifier as the convergence-guaranteeing filter -- echoed by BFCL executable eval.

hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Quote attested parameter values from raw-data sources; label inferred defaults when not attested
Opening chapter of the eval track -- introduce vocabulary (task-shape, metric, matcher, slicing, versioning, inference-config) that ch-48..ch-53 build on
